item.title: Tracking storms across the St. Louis region
item.description: Following a rise in temperatures Wednesday, storms are making their way into the area Thursday.

item.title: St. Charles County warns of 'criminal prosecution' over illegal gaming machines
item.description: Workers of bars, restaurants and gas stations with illegal gaming machines in St. Charles County could soon face criminal charges if they don't remove them by the end of March.

item.title: 67-year-old killed in motorcycle crash on Lemay Ferry Road
item.description: South County Precinct officers from the St. Louis County Police Department (SLCPD) are investigating a motorcycle accident that claimed the life of one person earlier this week on Lemay Ferry Road.

item.title: Why St. Louis-made Red Hot Riplets cannot be sold in California
item.description: If you've ever grabbed a bag of St. Louis-made Red Hot Riplets, you may have noticed a label near the expiration date that reads: "NOT FOR SALE IN CA," specifically the state of California.

item.title: Man who stole 100 guns while on probation gets his sentence
item.description: Jeremy Lorenz is an alleged serial burglar with active cases now in St. Charles County, Missouri, and Monroe County, Illinois.

item.title: Water system under pressure: St. Louis moves millions to prevent further breaks
item.description: It’s no secret – St. Louis City is old, and its aging infrastructure is costing millions in repairs. Aldermen are now considering using government rescue funds to really dig into permanent repairs.

item.title: 1 dead, 2 injured in Lemay crash Thursday morning
item.description: One man is dead and two other people injured following a violent car crash Thursday in south St. Louis County.

item.title: Father sentenced in Lincoln County child abuse case
item.description: Authorities said eight children, including a 1-year-old, were living inside a home filled with rotting food, feces, trash and insects. Some of the children were naked, covered in filth and ill when they were found.

item.title: Pacific residents push back against Data Center
item.description: A proposed $16 billion high-tech data center development in Franklin County has sparked an organized grassroots response from neighbors concerned about its environmental impact.

item.title: 3 rescued after two-story fire in Shaw neighborhood
item.description: Battalion 4 says one of the occupants saved from the dwelling was transported urgently to the hospital, where they were listed in critical condition.
